title: Privacy Policy
content:
Privacy Policy

Who we are

Warpstorm (warpstorm.online) — contact via our contact page.

What we collect

  • Standard server logs (IP, timestamp) — delivered by the host
  • Anonymous usage statistics (analytics)
  • Data you submit via contact forms (name, email, message)
  • Affiliate partners may set cookies when you click outbound links

Why

To operate, secure and improve the site, and to comply with legal obligations.

Your rights (GDPR)

You may request access, correction or deletion of your personal data at any time.
